programme.title: ESPN Film
programme.sub-title: The Day Diego Returned to the Azteca
programme.desc: In 2000 keerde Diego Armando Maradona voor het eerst sinds het winnen van de wereldtitel in 1986 terug in het Azteken-stadion in Mexico. Aan de hand van exclusief en zelden vertoond archiefmateriaal zien we de emotionele band die de Argentijn had met de plek van zijn Hand-van-God-goal in de kwartfinale tegen Engeland en de finale tegen West-Duitsland. Tijdens het WK van 2026 werd het Azteken-stadion het eerste stadion ooit waar drie mondiale eindtoernooien werden gespeeld.

programme.title: ESPN Vandaag
programme.desc: Een round-up van de dag met het belangrijkste en opvallendste (inter)nationale sportnieuws.

programme.title: ESPN DOC
programme.desc: Op 25 november 2025 is het precies vijf jaar geleden dat Diego Armando Maradona overleed. De Argentijn loodste zijn land in 1986 eigenhandig naar de wereldtitel en nam eind jaren 80 het toen nog kleine Napoli bij de hand op weg naar twee Italiaanse landstitels. In 'Op zoek naar Maradona' ontmoet AD-journalist Sjoerd Mossou - schrijver van het gelijknamige boek - verschillende mensen op wie Maradona grote indruk maakte.

programme.title: ESPN DOC
programme.desc: In 1985 wachtte PSV al jaren op een nieuwe landstitel. Het toenmalige bestuur gooide het roer om en wilde PSV een grotere uitstraling geven. De eerste grote aankoop was Ruud Gullit, de personificatie van het nieuwe PSV.

programme.title: ESPN Film
programme.desc: Op 8 juli 2010 maakte LeBron James bekend dat hij zijn Cleveland Cavaliers ging verruilen voor de Miami Heat. Hij deed dat in de live show ESPN's The Decision, een programma dat veel stof deed opwaaien.

programme.title: ESPN Film
programme.sub-title: Portrait of an Artist: Stephen Curry
programme.desc: Op 14 maart 2025 schreef Steph Curry geschiedenis door als eerste NBA-speler ooit de grens van 4000 driepunters te doorbreken. In deze documentaire wordt het schot van de ster van Golden State Warriors benaderd als kunstvorm. Van het jongetje dat in North Carolina opgroeide als zoon van een NBA-speler, via zijn college-jaren bij Davidson en entree in de Draft van 2009, tot het moment van het record. In die 4000 rake driepunters schilderde artiest Curry zijn eigen portret.

programme.desc: Programma met in het eerste uur muziek van Nederlandse bodem. Daarna neemt Wim een kopje koffie erbij om lekker te keuvelen. Luisteraars kunnen bellen met de studio en 'Op Tjak' doet verslag vanuit de regio.

programme.title: Anouk in de Middag
programme.desc: Anouk brengt sfeer en gezelligheid en praat de luisteraar bij over het laatste nieuws. Daarnaast draait ze muziek, geeft ze tips en wordt er een spelletje gespeeld. Op Tjak meldt zich ergens uit de provincie.

programme.title: Studio Steenbergen
programme.desc: René draait in het eerste uur van zijn programma hits uit de jaren zestig en zeventig. Daarna bespreekt hij hoe het in de showbizz gaat, wordt er een spelletje gespeeld en komen tips voor theater en film aan bod.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Squeakquel
programme.desc: The singing trio are left in the care of their manager's nephew and try to save a school's music programme by winning a battle-of-the-bands competition. However, they encounter fierce rivalry from another group of musical rodents. Comedy, starring Zachary Levi, Jason Lee and David Cross, with the voices of Justin Long and Christina Applegate.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: Chipwrecked
programme.desc: The singing rodents cause mayhem while performing on a tropical cruise, before they find themselves stranded on a desert island. As they search for a way to get back to civilisation, it becomes clear that they are not alone. Comedy sequel, starring Jason Lee and Jenny Slate, with the voices of Justin Long, Matthew Gray Gubler and Jesse McCartney.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Road Chip
programme.desc: The singing rodents mistakenly come to the conclusion that their human friend Dave intends to get rid of them when he proposes to his girlfriend in Miami. With only three days until Dave pops the question, the trio embark on a desperate road trip across America to sabotage his romantic plans. Family comedy sequel, starring Jason Lee and Kimberly Williams-Paisley.

Family comedy sequel, starring Jason Lee and Kimberly Williams-Paisley.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: A mischievous trio of talking chipmunks invade a struggling songwriter's home. When the furry critters demonstrate a remarkable talent for singing, he agrees to help them find fame and fortune. However, an unscrupulous record company boss has other plans. Children's comedy, starring Jason Lee and David Cross, with the voices of Justin Long, Matthew Gray Gubler and Jesse McCartney.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Squeakquel
programme.desc: The singing trio are left in the care of their manager's nephew and try to save a school's music programme by winning a battle-of-the-bands competition. programme.desc: Discover some of the very best Sky Originals to watch with the whole family, from Monster Family to The Amazing Maurice.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
programme.desc: After being bitten by a radioactive arachnid, student Miles Morales develops incredible abilities, and becomes a version of Spider-Man. When a super collider device opens a gateway to other dimensions, Miles crosses paths with five counterparts to stop a threat for all realities. Oscar-winning animated adventure, with the voices of Shameik Moore and Nicolas Cage.

programme.title: Spider-Man
programme.desc: A clumsy teenager develops superhuman powers after a genetically engineered spider bites him. At first his fantastic skills delight him, but his elation is severely tempered by a family tragedy, prompting him to dedicate his talents to combating evil. However, he faces a baptism of fire in the form of crazed villain the Green Goblin. Comic-book superhero adventure, with Tobey Maguire, Kirsten Dunst, Willem Dafoe, James Franco and Rosemary Harris.

programme.title: Spider-Man 2
programme.desc: Peter Parker continues his fight for justice, but unrequited love and personal worries take their toll and he is tempted to abandon his web-slinging alter ego. However, the arrival of deadly new bad guy Doctor Octopus plunges him into a race against time to save New York. Comic-book adventure sequel, with Tobey Maguire, Kirsten Dunst, Alfred Molina, James Franco and Rosemary Harris.

programme.title: Spider-Man 3
programme.desc: A sinister alien parasite brings out the web-slinging hero's darker side, filling him with thoughts of revenge on his uncle's murderer, the shape-shifting Sandman. Meanwhile, he also has to contend with the challenge of his best friend following in his father's villainous footsteps - and a jealous rival developing superpowers of his own. Superhero sequel, with Tobey Maguire, Kirsten Dunst and James Franco.

programme.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
programme.desc: A gifted teenager investigates the secrets hidden in his dead parents' past, leading him to a mysterious corporation and an incident that imbues him with superhuman powers. A personal tragedy drives him to use his new-found abilities to fight crime, and he is soon drawn into a deadly battle against a former colleague of his father, who has undergone a devastating transformation of his own. Superhero adventure reboot, starring Andrew Garfield, Emma Stone and Rhys Ifans.

programme.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
programme.desc: The webslinging hero battles a powerful new enemy when a downtrodden engineer develops lethal electrical powers, which he unleashes on those he believes have betrayed him. As if that wasn't enough to keep him busy, he faces an even greater threat when he is reunited with an unstable old friend who has been charged with a sinister mission by his dying father, leading to a series of tense confrontations that threaten to change his life for ever. Superhero adventure sequel, starring Andrew Garfield, Emma Stone, Jamie Foxx and Dane DeHaan.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
programme.desc: Peter Parker balances life as an ordinary high school student with his superhero alter-ego Spider-Man, while waiting in vain to join his mentor Iron Man on a world-saving mission. Determined to prove he is ready for bigger challenges, he investigates a spree of crimes committed with advanced weapons - leading him into a battle with a ruthless winged enemy on the hunt for priceless technology. Superhero adventure, starring Tom Holland, Michael Keaton and Robert Downey Jr.

programme.title: Woman on the Run
programme.desc: After witnessing a murder, Frank Johnson goes on the run to avoid being killed himself. His wife, Eleanor (Ann Sheridan), seems almost apathetic about finding him when questioned by Investigator Harris (Robert Keith), due to a marriage on the rocks. However, after learning that Frank has a grave heart condition, Eleanor recruits reporter Dan Leggett (Dennis O'Keefe) to help track down Frank. Discovering new love for her husband along the way, Eleanor must get to Frank before the killer does.

programme.desc: San Francisco businessman Harry Graham (Edmond O'Brien) and his wife and business partner, Eve (Joan Fontaine), are in the process of adopting a child. When private investigator Jordan (Edmund Gwenn) uncovers the fact that Graham has another wife, Phyllis (Ida Lupino), and a small child in Los Angeles, he confesses everything. In flashback, Graham tells of the strains in his marriage with Eve and how he found himself falling for the kind-hearted waitress Phyllis while on a business trip.

His wife, Eleanor (Ann Sheridan), seems almost apathetic about finding him when questioned by Investigator Harris (Robert Keith), due to a marriage on the rocks. However, after learning that Frank has a grave heart condition, Eleanor recruits reporter Dan Leggett (Dennis O'Keefe) to help track down Frank. Discovering new love for her husband along the way, Eleanor must get to Frank before the killer does.

programme.title: The Originals With Suzy Kolber

Suzy Kolber digs into the singular obsession that made him a Super Bowl winner, a wildly popular Monday Night Football analyst, and a social media sensation nobody saw coming. programme.title: Marshall
programme.desc: Young Thurgood Marshall faces one of his greatest challenges while working as a lawyer for the NAACP. Marshall travels to conservative Connecticut when wealthy socialite Eleanor Strubing accuses Black chauffeur Joseph Spell of sexual assault and attempted murder. He soon teams up with Sam Friedman, a local Jewish lawyer who's never handled a criminal case. Together, the two men build a defense while contending with racist and anti-Semitic views from those who deem Spell to be guilty.

programme.title: Flaming Bullets
programme.desc: A criminal syndicate has been illegally freeing convicts, only to murder them after authorities offer reward money for the fugitives' scalps. Texas Rangers Tex Haines (Tex Ritter), Dave Wyatt (Dave O'Brien) and "Panhandle" Perkins (Guy Wilkerson) are charged with catching the thugs, and they hit upon a plan: Dave will get himself put in jail, the thugs break him free and Tex and Panhandle will arrest them. But, when the criminals realize the Rangers are closing in, things turn deadly.

programme.title: Rimfire
programme.desc: An undercover Army captain (James Millican) links missing gold and murder to a gambler's (Reed Hadley) ghost.

programme.title: Stars Over Texas
programme.desc: Cowboys Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) have come to the end of a tough cattle drive, but, instead of the rancher they were expecting, they're welcomed by his sister, young Terry Lawrence (Shirley Patterson). It seems that Terry's brother and one of his employees were wounded by gun-toting thugs. Eddie and Soapy realize that they'll need to get to the bottom of things, so they devise a clever plan to lure the bad guys back to the scene.

programme.title: Return of the Lash
programme.desc: Cheyenne Davis (Lash La Rue) comes to the rescue of a group of ranchers who are losing their homes to a gang of malicious outlaws. When Davis and his sidekick, Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), capture the outlaws, they collect reward money to distribute to the ranchers. But Fuzzy, who is in charge of delivering it, loses the money as well as his memory. Now it's up to Davis to set things right and prevent land baron Jim Kirby (George Chesebro) from getting his hands on the cash.

programme.title: Stage to Mesa City
programme.desc: Valiant U.S. Marshal Cheyenne Davis (Al "Lash" La Rue) and his trusty deputy, Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), are on their way to aid a stagecoach owner who is mired in financial burdens. But, when they arrive and discover he's been murdered, the loyal pair are asked by Margie (Jennifer Holt), his daughter, to seek out his killers and make them pay for their vile crime. The investigation soon leads them to a sneering lawyer (Marshall Reed), who has a mysterious boss.

programme.title: Blue Steel
programme.desc: Undercover federal marshal John Carruthers (John Wayne) is suspected by the local sheriff, Jake (George Hayes), of stealing the town's payroll, but his suspicions are sidelined when young Betty Mason (Eleanor Hunt) announces that her father, an important businessman, has been murdered. Without him, supplies will not reach town, and homesteaders will starve. When town leader Malgrove (Edward Peil) offers to buy the locals out, John and Jake get suspicious, and uncover a land-grabbing conspiracy.

programme.desc: Captain Phillip Donlin (Lloyd Bridges) and his small troop must rush to reach Little Big Horn in order to warn General Custer of the Sioux attack that awaits him. John Haywood (John Ireland), who Donlin knows is having an affair with his wife, Celie (Marie Windsor).

programme.title: Under California Stars
programme.desc: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom.

programme.title: Vengeance Valley
programme.desc: Adopted by the wealthy rancher Arch Strobie, orphan Owen Daybright (Burt Lancaster) grows to be a respectable foreman on Strobie's ranch. Strobie's natural son, Lee (Robert Walker), is jealous of Owen and finally finds a way to undermine his upstanding brother. When Lee conceives an illegitimate child with Lily Fasken (Sally Forrest), who refuses to name him as the father, he tells her revenge-minded brothers that Owen is to blame, hoping they'll take his half-brother out of the picture.

programme.title: The Cowboy and the Indians
programme.desc: Rancher Gene Autry tries to aid neighboring Navajos suffering from malnutrition, but he is opposed by a crafty and crooked trading post proprietor.

programme.title: Panhandle
programme.desc: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown.

programme.title: Borderland
programme.desc: Hopalong Cassidy fools even his partner by acting like a badman to catch a gang of badmen.

programme.title: Massacre
programme.desc: A tribe of hostile Native Americans goes on the warpath, slaughtering white men with guns sold to them by mercenary outlaws.

programme.title: The Proud Rebel
programme.desc: Confederate veteran John Chandler (Alan Ladd) returns from defeat in war to find his home razed, his wife dead and his young son, David (David Ladd), traumatized and rendered mute. Desperate to cure the boy, Chandler takes David to a small town in Illinois where he hopes to find a doctor. But, soon after the pair arrives, Chandler finds himself framed for assault -- and forced to choose between serving hard time and working for struggling local farmer Linnett Moore (Olivia de Havilland).

programme.desc: Judy Canova (Judy Canova) is a capable cowgirl and a sassy shopkeeper in her frontier town. But, when Dan is abducted by a band of wild outlaws, it's up to Judy to round up a posse and save the day.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Grilled Squid Salad and Crispy Squid on the Plancha

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern explores Minnesota's forests for wild mushrooms. He creates a simple grilled mushroom salad, then hand-shapes cavatelli pasta tossed with golden chanterelles, butter, garlic, thyme, and colatura. He shares foraging and cleaning tips.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.title: Mama's Family
programme.desc: Thelma "Mama" Harper is the quick-tempered, blue-haired matriarch of the Harper family who lives with son Vint and his wife, Naomi, who were forced to move into Mama's basement after losing money in a business deal gone awry. After Vint's kids from a previous marriage leave the house, Mama's delinquent grandson Bubba is ordered to live with his grandmother after being released from juvenile hall and placed on probation. Iola Boylen, Thelma's friend and neighbor, is a frequent visitor to the Harper household, which is often the site of bickering between abrasive Mama and her loved ones. Vicki Lawrence stars as Mama, a character she originated in sketches on "The Carol Burnett Show.".

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.desc: Luis regala un nuevo producto a cada familia: el Espolón Pin Pon, un moderno cortaúñas de pies al que le están haciendo pruebas. Es por eso por lo que le pide su opinión a cada familia. Al mismo tiempo Luis se incomoda al ver todo el edificio lleno de polvo y obliga a Germán a tenerlo reluciente, pues su jefe irá de visita a recabar los resultados de las opiniones del Espolón Pin Pon. Cada familia hace pruebas para medir su eficacia.

programme.title: 40 y 20
programme.desc: Magali convence a Paco de recibir temporalmente a su amiga Cassandra, una hostess espectacular que necesita alojamiento urgente. Pero pronto se revela que Cassandra y Paco ya se conocen, de una boda donde él terminó ebrio y haciendo el ridículo.

programme.title: 40 y 20
programme.desc: Toña le pide permiso a Paco para hospedar a su padrino durante una noche. Desafortunadamente, el señor muere esa noche y deciden velarlo en el departamento de Paco.

programme.title: Renta congelada
programme.desc: Federico toma los ahorros de la familia para comprarse una cámara de video. Ana sube videos cantando a internet pensando que se volvería famosa, pero las cosas no salen como ella esperaba.

programme.title: Renta congelada
programme.desc: Los primos de Ana llegan a la ciudad para vivir con ella y su familia. Ana decide rentar su estudio como un cuarto de hotel para poder ganar dinero.

programme.title: Alma de Ángel
programme.desc: Gloria logra quitarle el amuleto a Paco y Alma vuelve a ocupar su cuerpo. Ángel lleva a un sacerdote para exorcizar a Alma, pero todo sale mal y ella se queda atrapada en el cuerpo de Paco.

programme.title: Alma de Ángel
programme.desc: Alma continúa atrapada en el cuerpo de Paco y corre el riesgo de desaparecer. Gloria encuentra la manera de salvar a Alma, pero eso significaría la muerte de Paco.

programme.title: Simón dice
programme.desc: Simón aconseja a los chicos que defiendan su territorio, tal como él lo hizo cuando El Hijo del Santo le reclamó a Diana por un error que cometió en la floristería.

programme.title: Simón dice

programme.title: Durmiendo con mi jefe

programme.title: Durmiendo con mi jefe
programme.desc: Carlos está metido en una penosa situación cuando su madre cree que él es gay; la esposa de Gael le pide a Carlos información de su esposo por lo que le triplicaría el sueldo.

programme.title: ¿Cuál es el bueno?
programme.desc: Rodrigo Murray, Sofía Escobosa y Harold Azuara son los cazafarsantes en esta ocasión y ponen a prueba sus habilidades para llevarse 50 mil pesos.

programme.title: XHDRBZ
programme.desc: Nelson Guerra presenta los grandes errores de los conductores de la televisión y las veces que repiten una palabra en el mismo diálogo. En "Peliculeando", está como invitado el reconocido cineasta don Óscar Ariel.

programme.title: Perdiendo el juicio
programme.desc: Un carismático juez, dos implacables fiscales y tres divertidos abogados se reúnen en una corte donde llevarán a juicio a diversas celebridades que se han enfrentado a escándalos a lo largo de sus carreras.

programme.title: Está libre
programme.desc: El muñeco de porcelana es un actor de películas subidas de tono, pero no sabe cómo explicárselo a su madre, quien lo sobreprotege. Chuy debe ayudarlo a enfrentar a su madre.

programme.title: Bola de locos
programme.desc: Maribel Guardia y Victoria Rufo están en busca del brujo Burundanga, pues creen que les han hecho brujería, ya que han perdido su talento.

programme.title: La CQ: Nuevo ingreso
programme.desc: El director les da la noticia que, para poder participar en la kermés, tendrán que pagar una cuota. Los alumnos buscarán la forma de pagar.

programme.title: La CQ: Nuevo ingreso
programme.desc: Es el gran día de la kermés de la CQ, y los alumnos se preparan para poner individualmente sus puestos y lograr ser el que más venda.

programme.title: ¿Es neta, Eva?
programme.desc: Eva y Antonio son llamados por la maestra para resolver los problemas de su hijo Dany, pues este comienza a tener malas calificaciones. Sin embargo, la terapia los hará descubrir una realidad que Eva no sabrá cómo enfrentar.

programme.title: El príncipe del barrio
programme.desc: Albertano decide mudarse a Lomas de Chacaltepec, un pueblo mágico donde su peculiar forma de ser lo mete en divertidos aprietos.

programme.title: ¿Tú crees?
programme.desc: La tranquilidad cotidiana en Tiendas del Sol se rompe cuando Romualdo aparece sin avisar y deja encargada a su carismática y deslumbrante Britny, quien rápidamente se convierte en el centro de atención de toda la tienda. Su presencia provoca celos, distracciones y un caos generalizado entre empleados y clientes, al grado de afectar el trabajo en todos los departamentos.

programme.title: Tal para cual
programme.desc: Aristeo, el tío de Nacaranda, llega a Nacotitlan para recoger unos estudios, pero ella y Nacole están preocupadas por su salud.

programme.title: Lo tomas o lo dejas
programme.desc: Ignacio, participante argentino, avanza con cautela mientras el tablero reduce sus opciones. Las ofertas de la banquera reflejan el riesgo creciente, y cada elección se vuelve crucial en un juego que mantiene la tensión hasta el final.

programme.title: Piensa rápido
programme.desc: Los Turistas y su tour por Turquía enfrentan a los Capibaras. Daina intenta alinear los chakras del Vítor, mientras Hilda baila salsa. Tras un acertijo de envidia, ¡ganan 5 500 dólares para su viaje a la Riviera Maya!

programme.title: La familia P. Luche
programme.desc: Una familia que trata con los conflictos y problemas de la vida diaria, pero en forma cómica y exagerada con la particularidad de que viven en una ciudad que está edificada en su totalidad de peluche y con todos los accesorios de peluche.

programme.title: Live: Hot Stove
programme.desc: Baby, it might be cold outside, and the springtime sounds of bats hitting balls are months away. What better way for baseball fans to cure the winter blues than to gather around the "Hot Stove" and warm up to the news of the offseason? MLB Network has all the angles covered for all 30 teams, from trades and free agent signings to the juicy rumors that percolate throughout, especially at the annual Winter Meetings in December. A host of former players, including Joe Magrane, Al Leiter, Sean Casey and Dan Plesac, analyze the news, supplemented by insider information from journalists Jon Heyman, Tom Verducci and Peter Gammons, among others.
